label: POLL
idea: A network of low-cost air-quality sensors sold to municipalities in northern Italy's Po Valley, with a public dashboard and SMS smog alerts for residents, priced per sensor per month.

steps.title: A Network of Low-Cost Air-Quality Sensors Sold

copilot.reply: You're developing an air-quality monitoring system for municipalities in northern Italy's Po Valley, providing affordable solutions with real-time data and alerts. To validate your business model and assumptions, I recommend conducting user interviews to understand the demand for such a service, willingness-to-pay, and potential pain points. Can you confirm if the target geography is specifically within the Po Valley region of northern Italy?

roles.description: Insights on the feasibility and adoption of low-cost air-quality sensors in municipalities, policy decisions, and budget constraints.
Understanding the needs and concerns of residents living in the Po Valley region, including awareness of air quality issues and willingness to adopt new technologies.
Insights on the technical feasibility and integration of low-cost air-quality sensors into existing municipal infrastructure, including data management and analysis.
Expert opinions on the accuracy and reliability of low-cost air-quality sensors, their potential impact on public health, and recommendations for sensor placement and maintenance.
Understanding the needs and concerns of small business owners in the Po Valley region, including potential benefits of air-quality monitoring for their operations and customers.
Insights on the motivations and behaviors of environmental activists in the Po Valley region, including their awareness of air quality issues and potential adoption of new technologies.
Understanding the needs and concerns of residents living in the Po Valley region with asthma, including awareness of air quality issues and willingness to adopt new technologies.
Insights on the political decisions and budget allocations related to air quality monitoring and management in municipalities, including potential support for low-cost sensors.
Insights on the government's policies and initiatives related to air quality monitoring, including potential support for low-cost sensors and funding for municipalities.

script: Can you describe your current experience with air quality monitoring in your community, and how often do you check for updates?
How do you currently stay informed about poor air quality in the Po Valley region when it's not a priority for local authorities?
Would you be willing to pay €10-15 per month for a low-cost sensor that provides real-time data on air quality and sends SMS alerts for hazardous conditions?
